title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.
Select bonsais to prune, purchase machinery upgrades, and manage inventory slots.
Open inventory and equipment backpack screen.
Switch between Greenhouse Sanctuary and Wilderness Excursion view.

sections.title: UI and Menus
sections.content:
1. Seedling Metadata Reorganization: Seedling cards in Sanctuary Grid Deployment replace the obsolete 'Shape' text with an aligned metadata badge cluster (Maturity rating, Tree type group, and Nature designation) directly beneath the species title. The attribute panel is titled 'Seedling Attributes' and formatted into a clean 2-column layout distinguishing Genetic Potential from Nature Factors. 2. 4-Column Attribute Telemetry & Vertical Clearance: The 'Choose Style to Plant' interface adopts a specialized 4-column layout titled 'Seedling Attributes': Column 1 (Genetic Potential progress bars), Column 2 ('Nature
Factor'), Column 3 ('Style
Factor'), and Column 4 ('Combined
Synergy'). The slim two-line column headers maximize horizontal real estate for progress bars. Vertical margins have been adjusted to prevent contact with the upper style tab bar and bottom action buttons. 3. Two-Decimal Base Aesthetic (BA) Precision: All BA metrics across inspection dashboards, sanctuary interaction HUDs, and inventory profiles strictly display two decimal places (e.g. '4.25 BA'). 4. Harmonized Inspection Architecture: The Bonsai Inspection Menu mirrors the 4-column attribute structure, presenting dual progress bars for GP and CP, slim Nature/Style/Synergy columns with colored directional arrows, and exact 2-decimal attribute BA contributions.
sections.summary: Unified 4-Column Attribute Telemetry, Two-Decimal Base Aesthetic Precision, and Ergonomic Viewport Clearance.
